name: po-pilot-mcp
description: Post-Stocky Shopify replenishment, vendor MOQ/carton Purchase Order generator, Stocky CSV supplier recovery, and Accounts Payable 3-way match MCP server.

calculate_replenishment_plan.description: Computes margin-weighted ABC classes, stockout-adjusted daily velocity, demand + lead-time variability safety stock, reorder points, and carton-rounded order recommendations.

build_supplier_purchase_orders.description: Groups SKUs by vendor, enforces carton multiples + supplier MOQ/USD thresholds via smart A-SKU top-ups, and outputs Shopify Native Draft PO CSVs + supplier emails.

reconcile_po_three_way_match.description: Cross-checks PO vs warehouse receiving vs supplier invoice to catch silent price creep, short-shipments, and unapproved fees, outputting a Debit Memo.

migrate_stocky_csv_snapshot.description: Reconstructs un-exportable supplier directory, real lead times, carton multiples, and SKU cost history from Stocky Purchase Order CSV exports.
